coupling.rationale: Clean one-directional layering (transport → builders → server fns → thin routes), DTOs at every boundary, and client/server code separated by module structure; no component reaches into another's internals.

abstraction_design.rationale: The shared builders and components stretch to similar cases (an Items page reuses Section/CardList/format and the data-server-route pattern) without flag parameters; the residue is copy-pasted route boilerplate and a duplicated card shape rather than missing or over-general abstractions.

findings.issue: Hidden-ability plumbing (extras param, CardData.hidden) crosses data/components/CSS layers but its only consumer is the abilities feature; removing abilities leaves it dead.
findings.suggestion: If the hidden flag were only needed on one page, derive it in buildAbilityPage's return shape or document that the card pipeline supports it; at minimum keep the plumbing adjacent to its consumer so removal is obvious.

findings.issue: buildHomeData builds a parallel card shape (HomeSpecies) with the same id/name/label/sprite/humanize logic as cardsFromPokemonRefs' CardData.
findings.suggestion: Build HomeSpecies from a shared cardFromSpeciesRef helper (or reuse CardData plus a types/generation field) so card construction changes land once.

findings.issue: The loader → null check → notFound() → head-title triple is duplicated verbatim across four $name route files.
findings.suggestion: Extract a tiny helper (e.g. routeHead(loaderData) and/or a makeDetailRoute loader wrapper) so each new resource route is one declarative hunk.

findings.issue: buildSearch re-encodes the 'omit empty/default params' rule that validateSearch already encodes, so the default-omission policy exists twice.
findings.suggestion: Have buildSearch go through validateSearch (validateSearch(buildSearch(...))) or share one canonicalize function.

findings.issue: The view builds typesByName and derives type labels via humanize(), even though buildHomeData already fetched the type records with English names for the select.
findings.suggestion: Return per-species type labels {name,label} from buildHomeData so label derivation lives in one layer.

findings.issue: NotFound sets document.title via useEffect DOM mutation instead of the router head mechanism.
findings.suggestion: Use the notFound route option/head API or a meta title on the route tree if the current stable version supports head for not-found; otherwise keep it but note why.

summary: This is a cleanly layered TanStack Start app: transport, server-side builders, server functions, and thin routes each own one concern, so data-source and sprite fixes land in single helpers. The costs are small but real: removing a feature means edits across three shared modules with some dead plumbing left behind, and four routes copy identical loader/head boilerplate. I'd happily accept it and ask for the card-shape and boilerplate consolidations as follow-ups.
